notes: Background: Large regional healthcare provider; EMR integrations and patient-facing chat assistants planned.

Compliance focus: Must demonstrate SOC 2 controls for change management, ISO 27001 mapping for ISMS, HIPAA/BAA specifics for PHI handling. PCI only applicable for billing integration — scope minimization requested.
KMS: Quillon insists on BYOK/HSM-backed key material, rotation policies, and documented key access logs. Wants KMS to live in their AWS account with cross-account grants.

Audit logging: Must deliver immutable audit logs for model requests and admin actions; retention 7 years for clinical audit trails; ability to forward to Splunk/Carbon Black/SIEM.

Security review items requested by Quillon: penetration testing policy, encryption-in-transit details, segmentation between tenant control planes, SOC 2 report excerpts, ISO 27001 scope statement, draft BAA language.

compliance_mapping_summary: SOC 2: Focus on CC6 (change management), CC7 (logical access), CC8 (system operations). Provide SOC 2 Type II report and control descriptions. Map Redwood controls to Quillon control IDs.
ISO 27001: Supply scope statement, evidence of ISMS policies, asset inventory and risk assessment summary. Show alignment of Redwood change control and incident response to ISO clauses A.12, A.14.

HIPAA / BAA: Clarify PHI flow, ePHI administrative/technical safeguards, encryption at rest (AES-256) + TLS1.2+ in transit. Provide draft BAA and evidence of administrative safeguards (training, access reviews).

PCI considerations: Not core but note cardholder data flow if payment tokens pass through Redwood. Recommend out-of-scope architecture option (client-side tokenization) and minimal retained logs for transaction traces only.
KMS & HSM: BYOK pattern with customer-managed CMK in customer AWS account, cross-account grants + CloudHSM option for FIPS/HSM-backed keys. Provide example IAM policies and rotation schedule docs.

Audit logging & retention: Deliverable options: (a) ship immutable logs to customer S3 with lifecycle rules; (b) forward events to customer SIEM via secure syslog/HTTPS. Retention configurable, default 7 years for clinical trails.
Data residency: Regional pinning for inference nodes, metadata tagging of logs. Provide proof-of-placement (region-specific hostnames + traceroute examples) for EU/US segregation.
Penetration testing & vulnerability: Share pentest cadence, remediation SLAs, and ability to coordinate red team exercises under NDA.
Operational runbook: Provide runbook excerpts for incident response (notification timelines), key compromise procedures, and customer offboarding data wipes.
Deliverables promised: compliance mapping doc (this note), sample BAA, KMS IAM policy templates, VPC architecture diagrams, audit-log forwarding config examples, SOC2 excerpt (redacted).
